content:
After most WhatsApp users on iOS officially received the Liquid Glass redesign, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focusing on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here are the details.

The new chat bubbles look more rounded

Months ago, WhatsApp finally rolled out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and refinement through TestFlight with selected users.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo discovered clues in the app's code pointing to a redesign of WhatsApp chat bubbles. The site is now reporting that the new bubble design is starting to roll out to select users running the latest TestFlight version.

Here's what WABetaInfo had to say:

In addition to changing the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links are presented in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around them, making photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more seamlessly integrated into the conversation.

According to WABetaInfo, the new interface is currently only available to select users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version. As for when it will roll out more broadly to all iOS users, there is no news at this time.
